notes.title: 10,000 PHP Competition
notes.content:
Whoever has the highest score in our game by 11:59pm on the 31st of January PHT will win 10,000PHP (About $200 USD) So get the game now and try to win!

(You'll need a copy of the game, and a PayPal, BDO, or BPI bank account to receive the prize money)

The competition has started!

PS: If you see the highscore with JTAGames at the top of the leaderboard it's probably us (more than one steam account can have the same name) So don't worry about that it's only for testing and making sure everything is working right.  We won't be participating in our competition.

NOTE: This competition is primarily for the Philippines so in order to receive the prize money you’ll need a BDO, BPI or PayPal account. No other method of delivering the prize money will be considered so if you want a chance to win you’ll need one of those as that is how we’ll award the money. 

CHEATERS BEWARE: It's easy for us to tell if you cheated, if you cheated your score will be removed from the score board and will not be eligible for the competition, and you risk being banned from the leaderboard permanently.

SCAM: We've received surprising feedback that people think this is a scam.  Don't worry if we are found to be fraudulent Valve (the people that own steam) would probably remove our game.  If you have any concerns please email us at Info@jtagames.com

notes.title: Major Updates
notes.content: Here at JTAGames we've been hard at work on our next title but we haven't forgotten about Escape Knox Manor.  We're Well on our way into creating 3 new puzzles as well as an increase in the games difficulty so it plays a little better. Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Fixed the bug that didn't let you open the game.

We're really sorry about that.  EKM should work normally again.
